answer: Operator Shared Escrow Freeze binds each agent identity to one operator escrow account, so a tundra deployment cannot hide duplicates behind fresh wallets. If any identity misbehaves, the protocol freezes the operator escrow and linked basalt registrations. Re-entry requires a jade receipt plus a fixed 0.05 ETH deposit per active identity and a cooldown. An attacker pays the full escrow and per-identity re-entry deposits for every sybil, not just a disposable wallet.
